claim: Frozen R2 decision algorithm/checkpoint with a separately versioned sensor-only execution lifecycle, not an unchanged full legacy episode and not a full-route-aware learned policy.

preserve_exact.execute_sensor_method: inherit exact original function object/body; no fork of candidate/rank/mask/control loop
sensor_model_semantics: same six-history tensor/features and actor checkpoint
same max input age .20s and runtime fail-closed health thresholds
same .25s replan/.05s controller and elapsed feature origin at inherited execute_sensor start; common gate time remains external formal time

observed_truth_paths.effect: unconditionally subscribes /gazebo/model_states and /m2_gazebo/contacts; no handle retained for model subscription
requires model existence/actor roster, calls Gazebo get_model_state and unpause
model truth can stop command generation before sensor policy branch
actor truth is diagnostic but runs in the command loop; remove it rather than silently return fabricated poses
legacy final pose/path/clearance/scientific inclusion are not the common source-stamped evaluator

proposed_override_surface.action: Use a new constructor adapter with the exact immutable R1 actor/runtime initialization block plus exact R2 apply_candidate_variant. Omit only simulator model/contact subscriptions and unused baseline subscriptions; add source ingress, common gate/status/path identity subscriptions. Do not monkeypatch global rospy.Subscriber or alter frozen parent source. AST-diff whitelist and runtime object equivalence must demonstrate constructor changes are transport/lifecycle only.
proposed_override_surface.reason: Calling super().__init__ then overriding _models leaves an oracle subscription in the deployment node; base did not retain its handle.

proposed_override_surface.action: Require progressing positive clock; exact run/seed/gate protocol identity; positive strictly increasing /odom and /scan source stamps and valid odom/base_link/laser frames; finite normalized pose; actual TF at accepted scan source; unchanged <=.20s scan/odom/TF health. Require six distinct successfully appended runtime scan stamps before arm, not len(scan_history) or raw scan count. No model/actor presence check or Gazebo service.
proposed_override_surface.reason: runtime_adapter.py initializes a6x72 max-range tensor, so its length is always6; current wrapper raw scan_stamps>=6 also does not prove six real accepted history entries.

proposed_override_surface.action: Retain new shared coordinator gate-only wait and exact gate acknowledgement; no method motion, goal service, or unpause before gate. Formal start/deadline derive from coordinator actual odom source.

Validate/queue immutable positive stamped messages until local clock covers them; reject lead or staleness beyond .20s, replay/regression/nonfinite frames. Then call unchanged parent callbacks, preserving legacy scan resampling and float .20s append rule. Count actual last_runtime_scan_stamp_s advances separately for readiness. Do not replace model history sampling with the new route node's integer buckets under old checkpoint identity.
proposed_override_surface.reason: Parent callbacks replace stamp0 with callback time and input_health clips future age to0; ingress must prevent these cases without changing valid-stream numerical observations.

proposed_override_surface.action: Return a dictionary derived from the latest accepted source odometry in the same fixed legacy frame as policy_pose: x=odom.x+spawn_world_x, y=odom.y, yaw=odom yaw. Initially admit only yaw0 legacy spawn/start/goal; stamp and source are separately logged. No model state fallback.

Compute diagnostic path increments only between distinct accepted source odom stamps, retain existing <=.25m step filter for legacy diagnostic comparability, and return sensor pose. Skip dynamic/static oracle clearance altogether; truth geometry belongs only to separate evaluator.

Return reached=True only for latched shared complete. For latched shared timeout/stopped raise a typed SharedTerminal carrying the actual phase, caught by new top-level orchestration; do not return True and falsely label timeout as a goal. On shared fault raise explicit LifecycleFault/zero. While active, sensor position/yaw errors are diagnostic and shared coordinator/evaluator alone decides formal arrival. Never inspect simulator model pose.
proposed_override_surface.caveat: The unchanged execute_sensor also has its local timeout and calls runtime.terminal_command; these remain disclosed sensor/algorithm behavior. Do not rebase elapsed policy features to the common gate without a new algorithm identity.

proposed_override_surface.action: Return no oracle data with explicit unavailable provenance; diagnostics are absent, not an assertion there are no actors.

Return explicit None in diagnostic trace slots; adapted common_metrics_step must not call min() on it. Keep internal legacy minimum accumulator unused so final finite_or_none is None. Never use the old radius metric as safety evidence; shared full-body bag evaluator computes authoritative clearance.

New node orchestrates adapted readiness/gate plus inherited execute_sensor and emits a new report schema. Do not expose inherited scientific_inclusion=True or zero contact counters as formal evidence. Stream completed decision/control trace rows independently of legacy final report and tail sleeps, so collector pause does not lose them.

Preserve proposed speed/yaw values exactly; record run/seed/gate epoch, monotonically increasing command sequence and actual publication/construction ROS source stamp in a new companion/envelope topic. Enforce post-gate emission. This does not prove old headerless commands' generation time retroactively or solve baseline timing by receipt relabeling.

forbidden_inputs_to_method: actor true states or policy/response parameters
allowed_method_inputs: actual shared coordinator gate/status derived only from odometry
shared static map and immutable route bundle metadata; no actor tracks
optional actual steering joints only for diagnostics unless separate algorithm version

route_fairness.availability_not_consumption: Subscribe/read/hash common Path and map, publish an input receipt including all path points, frames/reference, bundle/normalized occupancy SHA and declared usage. For frozen R2 explicitly route_use=audit_only, candidate_route_model=legacy_global_x, full_polyline_consumed=false.
route_fairness.map: Keep exact blocked-raster rectangle union adapter, including rotated/cylindrical source rasterization. Bind union audit. Retain explicit legacy +/-20m y walls and outside-map mismatch.
route_fairness.why_not_general_equivalence: Legacy _target_lateral(x,offset), previews, x-goal speed envelope and actor features use an absolute straight x reference. Replacing x with route arclength/Frenet poses, warping candidates, reranking/masking by guide or injecting a route corridor changes the policy/mask and cannot retain frozen-algorithm identity.

narrow_straight_route_adapter.admission: Before allocation validate every common path point is on exact canonical y=0, yaw0, monotonically increasing x, exact declared start/goal. Read start/goal from that validated guide and require equality to frozen constants. Bent/path endpoint mutations must reject rather than straighten.
narrow_straight_route_adapter.claim: Only straight-route input representation equivalence on a preregistered admitted population; not full arbitrary-route capability.
narrow_straight_route_adapter.constraint: Do not force an obstacle-crossing straight guide or select layouts from method results to qualify R2. It will not automatically cover all six independent-geometry families.

route_fairness.recommended_primary_interpretation: Keep sensor-lifecycle R2 as an explicitly frozen auxiliary/context comparator on the same episodes; primary shared-polyline method claims concern the route-consuming newPCT/analytic/actualTEB/DWA. This does not by itself satisfy a strict requirement that all five primary methods actually consume the same global path.
route_fairness.strict_five_method_requirement: Unresolved design constraint: either preregister a genuinely route-conditioned new fifth comparator with its own algorithm/checkpoint identity and retain R2 separately, or explicitly narrow the comparison/claim by authorized protocol choice. Do not silently relabel frozen R2 as route-aware or declare the original six-family/five-method requirement fulfilled.
route_fairness.future_route_aware_R2: New observation/action semantics require a new namespace and matched new checkpoint/training/qualification; old weights cannot be presented as a trained full-route model.

acceptance_before_any_primary_release: Deny every oracle subscription/service in a fake ROS graph; inject arbitrary changing model/actor states and demonstrate identical accepted sensor-stream actions and identical lifecycle results.

Bind immutable R1/R2/runtime/actorSHA and constructor AST whitelist; replay legal sensor histories against original runtime and compare observations, all8 previews, masks, analytic scores, learned ranking, commits and commands exactly (or preregister machine precision for deliberate rigid-frame extensions).

Start readiness with fewer than6 successful source-scan appends, padded history, duplicate stamp, zero stamp, future2ms and future>200ms, TF failure, stale>200ms; preserve old model-history sampling for accepted data.
Perturb coordinator vs old model truth near goal; only sensor/coordinator controls stopping. Preserve failure-inclusive timeout, late-terminal immutability and command-zero behavior.
Prove no inherited report or post-pause tail is necessary for final command/decision evidence; authoritative evaluator reads separate source-stamped bag.
For fullroute availability receipt, mutate path digest and missing map/path => startup rejection; demonstrate audit_only receipt never masquerades as predictor/candidate consumption.
For any narrow straight-route equivalence claim, path interior bend/changedgoal/reversedorder must reject before allocation; retain unsupported family strata without outcome-based exclusion.

Private Twist generation-time prerequisite remains open for all-method claims unless a source/gate-bound publication protocol is explicitly implemented/reviewed across methods; no receipt-to-generation relabeling.
